items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Xavier Cugat's band was on the stage in one of the theatres and all his instruments got wet... I really didn't get to audition again until June of that year.

ctx.x: In fact, it was quite a flood. We were stranded around there, the locality there for weeks without lights, without food, well, whatever food we had.

And Xavier Cugat's band was on the stage in one of the theatres and all his instruments got wet, got washed off the stage. It was quite a flood. And I really didn't get to audition again until June of that year. The flood was March 17, 1936. So by the time they cleaned up downtown and they got everything restored, back to normal again, I auditioned at the club and I went to work. They had another girl singing there and I was on trial for a week. We were making fourteen dollars a week on tips, and of course Jenny…
